$description: Organica design system — the single source of truth. shared/organica-tokens.css mirrors this file one-for-one; docs/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md documents it; Figma variables and text styles are named to match. When a value changes it changes HERE first, then in the CSS, then in Figma. Anything that disagrees with this file is a bug.

family.$description: One family, everywhere. Variable font, weight axis 200-800. Figma: load from Google Fonts.

weight.$description: The NUMBER is canonical, not the token name. Figma's weight picker shows the font's own style names, so each stop records the Manrope name it maps to — a token called 'medium' holding 400 would read as 'Regular' in Figma and the two would silently disagree.

light.$description: Manrope Light — panel sub-labels, labels and values

regular.$description: Manrope Regular — panel section titles and controls, body

size.$description: 1.2 (minor third) ratio anchored at 11px, rounded to whole pixels so text lands on the pixel grid in a dense UI. Nothing below 9px — it stops being readable at panel density.

display.$description: Hub wordmark only — fluid. In Figma use 96 as a fixed stand-in and keep the ratios (0.88 line height, -3% tracking).

tracking.$description: CSS em maps 1:1 to Figma percent — 0.08em = 8%. Do NOT type 0.08 into Figma. Panel type carries no tracking at all; only uppercase micro-labels in the header do.

lineHeight.$description: Unitless so it scales with the element's own size. In Figma enter as a percentage, not pixels, so the style survives a size change.

textStyle.$description: The composed roles — what become Figma text styles, one-for-one. A component references the ROLE, never a raw size or weight. The panel runs on TWO type styles (10/400 and 9/300); hierarchy is carried by COLOUR, not size: --ink for section titles, --accent for labels and controls, --mid for sub-labels and values.

panel/section.$description: Panel section title — Presets, Dither, Canopy. Sentence case. Same size and weight as panel/control; the two are told apart by colour (--ink vs --accent) and position, not by type.

panel/sub-label.$description: Subdivision inside a section — Algorithm, Resolution, Preview.

panel/label.$description: Control row label — Grid width, Gamma, Contrast.

panel/value.$description: Numeric readout. Tabular figures so values don't jitter under a dragging slider.

panel/control.$description: Interactive control text — segmented buttons, selects, inputs. One stop above its own label: a control has to read as actionable, and at 300 in a 26px row it goes soft. Stated as a role so the difference is a decision, not an accident of which rule was written last.

header/logo.$description: Tool wordmark in the header. The one place uppercase survives.

header/title.$description: Context title in the header — Sketch → SVG, Organic Forms.

display/wordmark.$description: Hub wordmark. Fluid on the web; in Figma pick a size per artboard and keep the ratios.

radius.$description: Organica's surfaces are flat and near-square — radius is a whisper, not a feature.

panelWidth.$description: One width for every control panel. Was 240 / 244 / 280.

rowHeight.$description: Every control row, so controls align down the column.

color.$description: Surface colours are per-tool (Halide is a darkroom, Komorebi a forest floor), so only the SYSTEM colours live here. Per-tool accents are listed under accent.

borderStrong.$description: Computed, not eyeballed: 3.27:1 on paper and 3.03:1 on panel, clearing WCAG 1.4.11 (3:1) on both surfaces a border can land on. A first pass at #b5a992 looked right and measured 2.08:1.

accent.$description: One identity colour per tool — the hub nav accent and the focus ring. Pick a hue that isn't taken when adding a tool.

mid.$description: The one text colour that IS systematic across tools (labels, values, sub-labels). Computed like borderStrong: 5.4:1 on paper, >=5.0:1 on panel -- real headroom above the 4.5:1 AA floor. A July 26, 2026 audit found three different values doing this job before unification: the then-shipped Strata's own --muted #888 (3.17:1, fails), Spore's --mid #c8c0b0 (1.62:1, fails badly), everyone else's #726a5e (4.43:1 on panel, fails). Every tool's --mid / --muted / --ink-muted must resolve to this value.
